vibe: Netflix political documentary + elite investigative journalism + cinematic intellectual landing page

headings.styling: tracking-tight, elegant, cinematic. Strongly encourage mixing normal and italic styles within the same headline to emphasize key political or digital terms.
headings.usage: Use Playfair Display for all major headings, blockquotes, and cinematic section titles. Do not use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use Inter for body copy, UI elements, data points, form inputs, and small labels to provide maximum readability against the stylized headings.

accents.styling: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs to text-sm font-bold
accents.usage: Use for overlines, badges (e.g., 'BEST SELLER'), and micro-copy.

spacing_and_layout.general: Use generous padding (p-12 to p-32) for section breathing room. Negative space is essential for the premium 'documentary' feel.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grids: Use asymmetrical Tetris Grids for the Audiences section. Break symmetry.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Center-align hero and large cinematic quotes. Left-align dense copy, timelines, and forms.
spacing_and_layout.mobile_first: Ensure all grids collapse to single columns on mobile. Font sizes scale gracefully using clamp() or responsive utility classes.

surface_strategies.navbar: Crystal Glass. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0F14]/80, border-b border-white/10. Sticky to top.
surface_strategies.cards: Dark elegant surfaces. bg-[#131A22] border border-white/5. On hover, apply subtle transforms and a faint red or gold box-shadow glow.
surface_strategies.pricing_cards: Use 'The Tracing Beam' or a glowing border concept. The 'Premium Bundle' should have a prominent #B8211A or #C9920A glow to signify 'Paling Diminati'.

animation_and_motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. Creates momentum and premium cinematic feel.
animation_and_motion.reveals: Framer motion for scroll-triggered fade-ups, staggering lists (e.g., timeline chapters), and parallax backgrounds.
animation_and_motion.interactions: Smooth transitions on buttons, subtle glow effects on card hover, animated counters for statistics.

components.ui_library: shadcn/ui heavily customized to match the dark cinematic theme. Do not leave the default Vercel aesthetic.

specific_usage.accordion: Use for FAQ and 'Apa yang Akan Anda Temukan?' (7 Bab). Redesign to look like editorial index/timeline.
specific_usage.cards: Use for Testimonials, Pricing, and Audiences.
specific_usage.forms: Use for Lead/Preorder form. Dark inputs (bg-black/20) with white text, red focus rings.
specific_usage.icons: lucide-react. Keep stroke widths delicate (1.5) for a sophisticated look.

textures_and_backgrounds.description: Grainy black and white abstract texture. Use with low opacity and multiply/overlay blend modes for cinematic noise.
Dark political architecture shadow. Use heavily tinted with #0B0F14 (opacity < 30%) as an atmospheric hero/quote background.

section_specific_instructions.hero: Headlines 'Ketika Algoritma Menjadi Alun-Alun Kekuasaan' using Playfair Display, italicizing 'Algoritma'. Show 3D mockup of the ebook using the front cover. Include badges 'BEST SELLER POLITICAL ANALYSIS 2026', dual CTAs.
section_specific_instructions.viral_stats: Political dashboard aesthetic. Use animated counters: '95,5% Kepuasan Publik' VS '3,55 Juta Penduduk Miskin'. Heavy bold font for numbers, accented in red/gold.
section_specific_instructions.timeline: Cinematic timeline for the 7 chapters. Use accordion to expand content. Left border should act as a glowing timeline track.
section_specific_instructions.audiences: Grid layout for 8 categories. Clean lucide icons, dark cards, smooth hover effects.
section_specific_instructions.editorial_quote: Massive Playfair Display blockquote over the dark political architecture image. High contrast, Financial Times/TIME vibe.
section_specific_instructions.ai_assistant: Futuristic WhatsApp chat mockup with dark transparent bubbles. Neon green/red subtle accents.
section_specific_instructions.lead_form: Sleek form. Submit button in #B8211A. Will be connected to MongoDB. Ensure data-testid on all inputs.
section_specific_instructions.urgency: Red-themed urgency section with a digital countdown. 'Di era politik algoritma, siapa yang menguasai konten, menguasai persepsi.'
section_specific_instructions.admin: Simple internal dashboard at /admin for viewing leads. Clean table, high readability.

testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='lead-form-submit').
